answer: Enrollment runs as a commit-reveal gate bound to a future beacon. Step 1: each applicant hashes a fresh secret, a 0.10-unit escrow, and one original work - a 14-line sonnet - into a crystal log; plaintext stays hidden until reveal. Step 2: one epoch later the beacon emits a seed; hashes are sampled at rate 1/10, matches activate, the rest wait in a bridge queue for the next round. Step 3: an attacker with N identities pays 0.10*N escrow; at rate 0.1, N=100 spends 10 units and rejected identities forfeit about 9 units per cycle - a recurring pure loss.
